result.introduction_draft: CO2 geological storage is a key mitigation option. Existing studies describe trapping mechanisms [w1] and solubility behavior [w2], yet coupled modeling under reservoir conditions remains limited. This work develops a coupled model and validates it against core-flooding experiments.

paragraphs.text: CO2 geological storage is a key mitigation option.
Existing studies describe trapping mechanisms [w1] and solubility behavior [w2].
Coupled modeling under reservoir conditions remains limited.
This work develops a coupled model and validates it against core-flooding experiments.

claims.claim: Trapping mechanisms are documented in prior work.
Solubility in brine has been measured.

evidence.note: w1/w2 均为输入真实文献；缺口由两篇共同推出。
